title: Thrivee Agent-Native Career Profile v0.2
description: Canonical JSON-LD representation of a person's persistent career state. Temporary market intent lives in the companion OpportunityIntent document.

artifact.description: A thing that exists and can substantiate a claim. An artifact is declared even when no URI is available, so evidence references always resolve to something inspectable.

capability.description: One capability collection distinguishes a tool (QGIS), a skill (spatial analysis), domain knowledge, and a demonstrated practice (conducting a transport accessibility analysis). A practice names the tools and skills it exercised through exercisesRefs. contextRefs situate a capability; context is not evidence.

disclosure.description: What an agent may discover without permission versus what requires an explicit grant. This object never records requester identities, marketplace transactions, or consent history; candidate-authorized disclosure to a named requester is the separate future DisclosureGrant contract.

disclosureSelector.description: Exactly one selector dimension is populated, which makes rule precedence deterministic: entityRefs beats sensitivities, which beats collections, which beats the default.

evidence.description: A first-class directional edge from a capability claim to what supports it. Verification of an evidence record is a separate Verification whose targetRef points back at it.

freshness.description: Factual recency metadata only. lastSubjectConfirmedAt is the latest validity.lastConfirmedAt in the document and lastVerificationAt is the latest confirmed verification date; both are null when none exists. This is deliberately not a profile quality, completeness, or strength score.

instant.description: A calendar date, or a UTC date-time, at which something was observed or recorded.

jsonLdContext.description: Inline transport-safe context. `id` and `type` are JSON-LD keyword aliases, so every identified entity is a real JSON-LD node rather than an anonymous nested object. contexts/career-v0.2.context.jsonld carries the full term definitions.

provenance.description: Origination, verification, confidence and source location stay separate dimensions. A verificationStatus other than self-attested or unverified additionally requires a confirmed Verification record resolving to the claim or its owning entity.

taxonomyCandidate.description: A possible code that has not been adopted. `agent-suggested` is allowed here and nowhere else; a candidate never becomes the resolved mapping without review.

taxonomyMapping.description: A first-class, provenance-aware mapping from a local subject to an external framework. An unknown mapping stays unknown: record mappingStatus `unmapped` or `ambiguous` rather than omitting the mapping or adopting a guess.

validity.description: Temporal metadata for state that can become stale. `observedAt` is when a producer observed the state. `lastConfirmedAt` is set only when the subject or an authoritative issuer confirmed it; extraction time is not confirmation.

verification.description: Who checked what, how, when, and with what outcome. Verification is modelled once, pointing at its target; targets do not carry back-references.
